lens: Simulated Simogo lens; independent design review, not Simogo's opinion

scope.intentionalConstraints: Black space, Geist Mono, small cube, eleven sequential places and slow transitions treated as approved design decisions.

evidenceSnapshots.use: Original unchanged chapter, world, menu, guide, result and song surfaces. Original 21-lugares superseded by final capture.
Final changed places, collection book and saved-place layouts.

scoreBasis.visual: Rendered composition only: restrained chapter fields retain the small central cube; the song screen creates a legible, spacious constellation of earned and missing places. The observed panels have clear type and primary actions. Static mobile fixtures do not establish motion quality. Final changed captures preserve the established typography and panel language; locked names are legible and the book shows the item title before its portrait. These limited refinements do not change the overall score.
scoreBasis.audio: Unscored: source inspection establishes arrangement intent, not perceptual audio quality.
scoreBasis.creativity: Observed visual vocabulary plus source-defined narrative mechanism: a player's remembered phrases become the closing arrangement, and five earned rings lead into six discoveries. No claim about the felt originality of live play.
scoreBasis.sensation: Unscored: no first-hand play or listening.
scoreBasis.cohesion: Observed copy and source-defined structure agree: five completed chapters open a larger eleven-place world, progress becomes a song, and menu/result actions point to the same next place. This score covers authored structure and visible consistency.
scoreBasis.polish: Rendered mobile surfaces and source-defined finale controls only: result, guide, menu and song layouts are organized and readable; the dynamic stages join shared dialog focus handling. Temporal pacing, actual controls and full finale rendering were not exercised. The final saved-place view displays one clear saved card, and collection filters are folded above the visible card. Saved-entry scroll behavior was read in source and remains unexecuted; no score increase is inferred.

strengths.observation: Five colored solid rings and six dim dashed rings make the unfinished composition legible at a glance, with names following the same circular order. The remaining black space gives this summary room to act as a quiet visual destination.

The five-chapter closing text explicitly leaves six places to discover, while the eleven-place finale declares the song complete. This gives the intermediate ending and the ultimate ending different narrative purposes.
Jardín remains the next destination across world marker, places sheet, menu and result. Repeated 'Seguir hacia Jardín' supplies a coherent thread through otherwise different interfaces.
The guide translates the garden into three concrete gestures and highlights the current one; its local hint responds to the planting target rather than presenting only a general manual.

findings.observation: The supplied song image is a five-of-eleven progress view. Neither the journey credit sequence nor the eleven-place finale credits are rendered in the inspected evidence.
findings.consequence: The complete narrative closure, credit/ring composition and readability during those transitions remain unverified; the progress image cannot establish their visual finish.
findings.remedy: Review timed captures of the actual five-chapter and eleven-place endings, including phrase, silence, credits and exit phases, at this viewport.

findings.observation: Finale timing and exits were read as source only. The journey offers a delayed skip and a credit-phase exploration button; the shared keyboard handler also exposes Escape.
findings.consequence: Discoverability, interruption timing and the felt transition back to exploration cannot be assessed from the static fixtures.
findings.remedy: Observe one uninterrupted ending and one deliberate exit using touch and keyboard, checking the credit reveal and returned world state.

limits: All screenshots are scripted local fixtures, including forced panels; they do not establish normal discovery, rarity, player understanding or human outcomes.
No listening occurred. Technical audio structure was not converted into an audio or sensation score.
No blocking visual defect is established by the inspected evidence. Scores cover only the explicitly stated scope; unseen captures and live interaction are not implied.

Final scope combines explicitly identified snapshots: only 21-lugares, 32-libro and 34-favoritos were freshly captured at 3c9d5dbc. The unchanged finale was still not rendered or heard. Source-only saved-entry scrolling and filter persistence are not interaction verification.
